settings.title: Settings
settings.general_language_desc: Choose the application interface language. Layout will automatically switch between right-to-left (Arabic) and left-to-right (English).
settings.general_autostart_desc: When enabled, Azkare will launch automatically every time you turn on your computer — no need to open it manually.
settings.overlay_mode_desc: Choose how you want to see Adhkar: on the desktop background, as notifications only, or both together.
settings.overlay_backend_desc: The technical method used to display text on your desktop. The default engine works on all systems. The eww option is for advanced Linux users who already use eww widgets.
settings.overlay_position_desc: Choose where on the screen the Dhikr text appears. You can drag it freely or pick a preset corner or center.
settings.overlay_drag_mode_desc: Click to enter drag mode and move the Dhikr text anywhere on your screen with your mouse.
settings.overlay_monitor_desc: If you have multiple monitors, choose which one to show Adhkar on.
settings.overlay_timer_desc: How long should each Dhikr stay on screen before switching to the next one?
settings.appearance_font_desc: Choose the font family used to display Adhkar text on your desktop.
settings.appearance_font_size_desc: Size of the displayed text. Increase for easier reading, decrease for a smaller footprint on screen.
settings.appearance_color_desc: Choose the color of the Dhikr text. We recommend choosing a color that stands out clearly against your wallpaper.
settings.appearance_shadow_desc: Add a subtle shadow around the letters to make the text readable regardless of wallpaper color.
settings.notifications_enabled_desc: When enabled, a notification will appear at the interval you set below, displaying a new Dhikr or Dua reminder.
settings.notifications_interval_desc: How often should a Dhikr notification appear?
settings.content_categories_desc: Choose which types of Adhkar and Duas to display. You can enable or disable any category.
settings.content_shuffle_desc: When enabled, Adhkar are displayed in a random order instead of a fixed sequence.
settings.content_show_source_desc: When enabled, the hadith reference (e.g. Bukhari, Muslim) is shown below each Dhikr text.
settings.content_show_translation_desc: Display an English translation below each Arabic Dhikr text.
settings.about_up_to_date: You are running the latest version.
